verdict.rationale: three.js is itself the official JavaScript library, published on npm as `three` (0.186.0, MIT, very high weekly downloads), with an official repo and API documentation. Coding agents drive it directly through npm. Coverage is not complete because only the JS package is official: the TypeScript typings (@types/three) have mismatched signatures that the maintainer won't maintain, and there are no other official language SDKs. missing for 10: officially maintained TypeScript typings, SDKs for additional languages/runtimes, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
